entries.title: The app on your other computers keeps up with your first mate's version
entries.body: When the Infinitary app on another computer is older than the computer your first mate runs on, it now gets that same version by itself and starts again on it once nobody is using it there. Its row in Settings → Devices says how far it has got, and Update app gets it right away and starts it again as soon as nothing typed there is left unsent. When it cannot update by itself, its row and a card say why and what to do there.

picture.alt: A computer's row in Settings, Devices saying its app has the first mate's version ready and starts again once nobody uses it, beside an Update app button
